Name: USER_DISP_LOG_PARAM_ST
Description: Messages in the on-screen event log (pick-ups, unlocks, rescues, defeats), with their icon, sounds and how they are kept in the expedition's history and on the map.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Message of the log entry (Menu Text). -1: none.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon shown next to the message. -1: the default icon.

Fields.Name: Text ID: History
Fields.Description: Menu Text used for the entry in the expedition history. -1: the event is not recorded in the history.

Fields.Name: Map Icon ID
Fields.Description: Icon of the event's marker on the map and in the history (for events with a position). 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Display Condition
Fields.Description: 0: always shown. 1: shown only when the event's map passes a map check. 2: shown only for events that carry a flag, which also selects the second sound. Retail 1 on 56 rows (unlocks), 2 on 2 (Evergaol opened).

Fields.Name: Switch Sound by Player
Fields.Description: Set: the sound depends on the character the event concerns: Sound ID: Self or Sound ID: Others. 0: always Sound ID: Self. Retail: set on 75 rows.

Fields.Name: Rarity
Fields.Description: Rarity passed to the log entry (1 Common, 2 Uncommon, 3 Rare, 4 Legendary, 10 Unique; 0 none), as on the item and armament messages.

Fields.Name: Show Player Icon
Fields.Description: Set: the entry shows the player's hero portrait and name. Retail: set on 41 rows.

Fields.Name: History Record Type
Fields.Description: 0: not recorded in the history. 1: recorded once per message. 2: recorded once per source (for example each defeated enemy). Retail 2 on 121 rows, 1 on 11.

Fields.Name: History Position
Fields.Description: Map position stored with the history entry. 1: a position taken from the world map. 2: the position of the event. 0: none (no map marker). Retail 1 on 146 rows, 2 on 30.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail 0.

Fields.Name: Sound ID: Self
Fields.Description: Sound played with the message. Used for every message when Switch Sound by Player is 0; otherwise only when the event concerns the player's own character.

Fields.Name: Sound ID: Others
Fields.Description: Sound played with the message for events about other characters, when Switch Sound by Player is set. With Display Condition 2, also used for flagged events. -1: none.
